name: Fire in the Hole xBomb

features.name: xBomb wilds
features.description: Exploding wilds destroy surrounding symbols and unlock rows.

features.name: Lucky Wagon spins
features.description: Persistent sticky multipliers on a fully unlocked grid.

review:
Dwarves in a collapsing mine, where xBomb wilds blow open extra rows and raise the multiplier as they go.

The Lucky Wagon bonus has sticky multipliers, so the later spins of a bonus are the most exciting. It strikes a nice balance: Nolimit-level upside, but with a gameplay loop you can actually follow. Very high volatility, 60,000x max.
author: editorial-team
